plan.notes: Source: official Monmouth University Registrar document 'B.S. in Computer Science (CS.BS) 2026-2027' sequence-chart PDF (https://www.monmouth.edu/registrar/documents/b-s-in-computer-science-cs-bs-4.pdf/), cross-verified identical against the live 2026-2027 undergraduate catalog page (https://catalog.monmouth.edu/undergraduate-catalog/science/computer-science-software-engineering/computer-science-bs/). Transcribed manually row-by-row from the official Sequence Chart (First Year through Fourth Year, Fall/Spring); term totals verified against the chart's printed Semester Credits (14/16/14/16/16/16/13/15) and the chart's published Total Credits 120. Prerequisites taken from the same 2026-2027 catalog's course descriptions: CS department (https://catalog.monmouth.edu/undergraduate-catalog/science/computer-science-software-engineering/computer-science-software-engineering.pdf) and Mathematics department (https://catalog.monmouth.edu/undergraduate-catalog/science/mathematics/mathematics.pdf); catalog alternative paths documented per-course. Caveats: (1) The chart merges each lecture+lab row (CS-175/175L, CS-176/176L, CS-205/205L); they are modeled here as separate courses matching the catalog course list, credits split 3+1, term totals unchanged. (2) Catalog corequisites are modeled as prereq links (e.g. CS-175L->CS-175) with a note, since they must be taken together. (3) The catalog lists no prerequisites for CS-310; none invented. (4) Free electives: the requirements table says 8 credits with a footnote 'Please consult with your advisor regarding the required number of free electives that must be completed'; the Sequence Chart itself shows only 4 credits (3 cr Spring Year 1 + 1 cr Fall Year 4 with EX) and still sums to 120. (5) Internal catalog inconsistency (documented honestly): the requirements table headers say Major Requirements/Computer Science (54 credits) and Interdisciplinary Requirements (28 credits), but their line items sum to 57 and 25 respectively; both the headers and the line items sum to 120 overall, and the Sequence Chart - the official term-by-term plan - sums to exactly 120 with the catalog's published Total Credits 120, so total_credits=120 follows the Sequence Chart. (6) The two 'Outside the Major Lab Science' rows (Fall/Spring Year 3) must come from the SAME science group per the curriculum chart: Group A = CE-111/111L + CE-112/112L (General Chemistry I+II with labs); Group B = PH-211/211L + PH-212/212L (General Physics with Calculus I+II with labs); Group C = BY-109/BY-110 + 4 additional credits from the listed BY/CE/PH/MA courses. (7) CS electives: 6 credits at the 200 level or higher excluding CS-215, CS-288, CS-289, CS-388, CS-389, CS-488, CS-489; 3 credits at the 400 level or higher except CS-488 and CS-489. (8) MA-109 assumes placement: catalog prerequisite is MA-101 (C or higher) or math placement level 3/4; MA-101 is pre-college-level and not part of the degree plan, so placement details live here in notes, not in external_prereqs. (9) 54 credits must be completed at the 200-level or higher (catalog note). (10) Writing Intensive is satisfied in-plan by CS-310 and CS-325 (both WT); Reasoned Oral Discourse by CS-492A/CS-492B (RD); Technological Literacy by CS-104 (TL); Experiential Education by the 1-credit free elective (EX). (11) EN-101/EN-102 may be required by some upper courses; CS-325 lists EN-101 and EN-102 as prerequisites and is sequenced after them in the chart.
